description: Automatically creates a memo in Caspio RIMS_MEMOS table after each call ends. Includes full transcript, call summary, sentiment analysis, and custom analysis data. Automatically matches customer by phone number.
notes: - Looks up customer by phone number in RIMS_DATA
- If not found: Creates memo with vac_id = 'UNKNOWN'
- Call ID, date, duration, phone number

retell_dashboard_setup.step_7: Test by making a call to your Retell agent

exclude_transcript.description: Create smaller memos without full transcript

agent_specific.description: Only log calls from specific agent (configure in webhook filter)

webhook_not_firing: Check webhook is enabled in Retell dashboard
customer_not_found: Not an error - memo is created with vac_id = 'UNKNOWN'
Update customer phone in RIMS_DATA to match caller
Phone numbers must match exactly (normalized to digits only)
retell_api_error: Verify RETELL_API_KEY is set in Railway
Check API key has correct permissions
View error details in Railway logs
